use_case_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary: user-facing contextual support chat (low-latency), secondary: semantic search over docs + reranking for search results, personalization snippets in-app. High read frequency during business hours in EU. Want consistent p50 <100ms for chat in EU, throughput ~300 reqs/minish sustained during peaks. Cost-sensitive; will compare hosted per-token vs dedicated reserved capacity pricing.
notes:
- Summary: evaluating hosted API first (quick POC), then Dedicated if economics and EU residency check out.
- POC details: 2-week hosted API test routed EU traffic to hosted-eu region. Observed: p50 ~120ms for short chat turns (prompt+100 tokens) from eu-west; ~180ms when routing to us-east. CTO says: "If we can get p50 sub-80ms in EU, it's a go for dedicated commit."
- Dedicated interest: reserved GPU pools + local KV cache to hit latency targets, and guaranteed throughput for peak analyses. They like Redwood's autoscale + burst for conference days.
- Data residency: absolute requirement for logs/LLM cache (no US egress). Legal: DPA + SCCs needed before procurement.
- Multi-region routing ask: prefer primary EU zone + failover to global only if capacity constrained; want control over routing policy per route. Concern: tradeoffs between lower latency (local) vs lower unit-cost (centralized pool).
- Cost sensitivity: Finance asked for 3-year NPV on token pricing; current hosted run extrapolated to ~140k/mo costs at 1.2M tokens/day → wants dedicated quote with commit tiers.
- Security: SSO/SAML, Audit logs, KMS for key material, 90-day retention configurable.
- Technical: SE Jonah ran baseline with 512-token context, KV prefix cache reduced repeated prompt cost by ~22%. Suggested: local prefix caching + quantized model variant on Dedicated.
- Quote/procurement: product team prefers Q2 sign; finance + legal timeline pushes to late Q2.
- Customer quotes: Product Lead: "We need predictable latency for EU customers — even 50ms feels like a big win for conversational UX."
- Internal notes: consider offering EU-only Dedicated bundle (price + 99.9% EU availability) and a routing policy doc for them.
